name: Ritual Mask of Bad Advice
description: Recovered from a sealed archaeological display. The mask emits unstable psychokinetic readings and appears unusually responsive to nearby human voices.

name: Possessed Clock
description: An antique clock associated with repeated time-loss reports. Residual energy remains strongest around the winding mechanism.

name: Ectoplasmic Idol
description: A carved idol coated in persistent ectoplasmic residue. Activity increases when the object is moved away from its original resting place.

name: Cursed Music Box
description: A damaged music box producing anomalous readings even while mechanically inactive. Strong psychokinetic energy remains trapped inside the mechanism.

name: Spectral Lens
description: An unusual glass lens recovered near a high-energy manifestation. When exposed to strong PKE fields, its surface develops a faint internal glow.

name: Unknown Entity
description: Scan data remains incomplete. Additional readings are required before a complete profile can be constructed.

name: Bellhop Phantom
description: This highly active manifestation has been repeatedly observed moving through the upper floors of an old hotel. Witnesses report sudden drops in temperature, flickering lights, slamming service doors, and the sound of a brass bell ringing even when no one is near the front desk. Initial PKE readings suggest the entity is strongly bound to the building and becomes more aggressive when pursued. It is capable of manipulating small objects, disrupting electrical equipment, and briefly appearing in reflective surfaces before vanishing. Extended scanning indicates that the phantom follows a repeating route through several hallways, but the pattern changes whenever it detects a nearby investigator. Approach with caution and maintain continuous PKE monitoring until the entity is contained.
